description: This is a Java source file defining the 'PaymentWorker' class, which contains utility methods for handling payments within the OFBiz framework, such as retrieving payment methods, calculating totals, and querying payment applications.

classes.name: PaymentWorker
classes.description: Utility class providing static methods for processing payments, payment methods, and related financial calculations within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: getPartyPaymentMethodValueMaps
methods.description: Retrieves a list of payment method representations for a given party, optionally including or excluding old payment methods.

methods.name: getPaymentMethodAndRelated
methods.description: Fetches a PaymentMethod and its related entities (CreditCard, GiftCard, EftAccount, CheckAccount) based on request parameters and attributes.

methods.name: getPaymentAddress
methods.description: Fetches the primary address associated with a party's payment location.

methods.name: getPaymentsTotal
methods.description: Calculates the total amount from a list of Payment entities.

methods.name: getPaymentApplied
methods.description: Calculates the total amount applied to a specific payment, with options for actual/estimated amounts.

methods.name: getPaymentAppliedAmount
methods.description: Retrieves the applied amount for a payment application, considering currency conversions if necessary.

methods.name: getPaymentApplied
methods.description: Overloaded method to calculate total applied amount based on payment entity.

methods.name: getPaymentApplied
methods.description: Calculates total applied amount to a payment, considering currency conversions if applicable.

methods.name: getPaymentNotApplied
methods.description: Computes the remaining amount not yet applied for a payment.

methods.name: getPaymentNotApplied
methods.description: Computes the remaining amount not yet applied for a payment, with currency consideration.

methods.name: getPaymentNotApplied
methods.description: Overloaded method to calculate the not applied amount for a payment by payment ID.

methods.name: getPaymentNotApplied
methods.description: Calculates the remaining unapplied amount considering currency exchange.
